sources.title: The OFFICIAL Monster Raving Loony Party Manicfesto for General Election 2024
sources.publisher: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party (party site)
sources.notes: Most recent national manicfesto; the same items were repeated in the party's July 2026 Clacton by-election manicfesto. Text copied from the page's HTML.

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged to abolish inheritance tax.
claims.source_quote: A Restore Britain government would abolish IHT.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain states it would freeze working-age benefits, as part of a plan to claw back £178 billion of what it describes as excess spending accumulated since 2019.
claims.source_quote: The party's answer is to claw back £178 billion of the £300 billion in excess spending accumulated since 2019, roughly £35 billion a year, through a freeze on working-age benefits and QUANGO budgets, reform of the pensions triple lock, and the end of Net Zero-related public expenditure.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged to require developers to fund local infrastructure in an area before construction of new housing begins.
claims.source_quote: Developers would be required to fund local infrastructure in the area before a shovel goes in the ground. British homes for British families.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged to abolish stamp duty, as part of a package it costs at £155-156 billion of tax cuts.
claims.source_quote: Every pound saved is earmarked to fund £155-156 billion of tax cuts, including a higher personal allowance, a restored 19% rate of corporation tax, and the abolition of inheritance tax, stamp duty, and insurance premium tax.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged to remove the cap on medical school places and states the NHS would then be required to employ British-trained staff over foreign staff.
claims.source_quote: Medical school caps will be demolished. We would allow talented young British men and women to train in medicine. The NHS will then be forced to employ them over foreign staff.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged to repeal the assisted dying bill.
claims.source_quote: Restore Britain would repeal the assisted dying bill and reverse the changes that permit abortion up to birth.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged to let families take children out of school for up to five school days a year during term time without being fined.
claims.source_quote: Families should have the freedom to take children on meaningful trips inside term time without being fined by the state, for up to five school days a year.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain states that university staff it describes as pushing anti-British ideology should hold no position in a publicly funded British university, and that courses it describes as brainwashing students should be shut down.
claims.source_quote: Professors and administrative staff pushing anti-British ideology should hold no position in a publicly funded British university. Courses that brainwash students into hating their own culture should be shut down. In the most egregious cases, inquiries pertaining to entire universities must be held.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged to repeal the Climate Change Act 2008 and remove the Net Zero-related levies, subsidies and pricing mechanisms associated with it.
claims.source_quote: Repeal the Climate Change Act 2008 and remove associated Net Zero-related levies, subsidies, and pricing mechanisms that inflate system-wide energy costs.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged a nationwide programme of Small Modular Reactors as part of an expansion of nuclear power.
claims.source_quote: Accelerate nuclear expansion, including a nationwide programme of Small Modular Reactors (SMRs).
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged a binding referendum on restoring the death penalty.
claims.source_quote: Hold a Binding Referendum on Restoring the Death Penalty.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged to permit women to carry and use pepper spray for self-defence.
claims.source_quote: Women should be permitted to carry and use pepper spray – a tool used by the police themselves – to defend against attackers.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged to scrap all forms of foreign aid that it judges do nothing to advance Britain's national interests.
claims.source_quote: All forms of foreign aid that do nothing to advance Britain's national interests in the world would be scrapped.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged to abolish all diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) programmes across government departments, including the Ministry of Defence.
claims.source_quote: A Restore Britain government would abolish every trace of DEI across all government departments. Nowhere does this matter more than within the Ministry of Defence.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged to repeal the Gender Recognition Act and to stop the state issuing legal documents that change a person's sex in law.
claims.source_quote: In view of these principles, the Gender Recognition Act must be repealed. The state must no longer issue legal documents that permit individuals to change their sex in law.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain pledged, under the heading 'Ban the Burqa', to ban the burqa and the niqab, which it describes as having no place on British high streets.
claims.source_quote: Both the burqa and the niqab are fundamentally un-British and have no place on our high streets.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Climate Party says its programme is about rebuilding key infrastructure, regaining energy independence, reducing the cost of living and creating new jobs, without giving figures.
claims.source_quote: But this is about doing what's right for us: rebuilding our key infrastructure, regaining our energy independence, reducing the cost of living, and rejuvenating our communities through new jobs and opportunities.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Climate Party says air quality will improve dramatically as petrol and diesel vehicles are phased out, without giving a date or target.
claims.source_quote: As petrol and diesel vehicles become a thing of the past, and ecosystem services come to the fore, we will see a dramatic improvement in air quality.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Climate Party says it would integrate skills for climate change services and ecosystem services into the educational curriculum and offer vocational training programmes focused on clean industries.
claims.source_quote: Integrating the new skills required for Climate Change Services and Ecosystem Services into the educational curriculum and offering vocational training programs that focus specifically on clean industries such as renewable energy, sustainable agriculture, and sustainable manufacturing, could have a profound impact on job opportunities and attract investment into education and training services.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Climate Party pledged a legally binding government target of Net Zero by 2030.
claims.source_quote: First, establish a robust government target for achieving Net Zero by 2030, and enshrine it in legislation.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Climate Party pledged to restore 30% of nature by 2030 and 50% by 2050, through private investment.
claims.source_quote: Climate Party is dedicated to reversing this trend by preserving our natural landscapes and providing new opportunities for private investment to restore 30% of nature by 2030 and 50% by 2050.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UK Voice pledged public ownership of water and energy supply.
claims.source_quote: Public ownership of water and energy supply
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UK Voice says it would raise taxes on large multinationals rather than small businesses, without giving rates.
claims.source_quote: Higher taxes on large multinationals, not small businesses
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UK Voice says the NHS should remain free at the point of use and be funded through corporate taxation, without giving figures.
claims.source_quote: Free at the point of use. Better funded through corporate taxation. Less bureaucracy, more investment in the people and services that matter.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UK Voice says it supports lower university tuition fees, without giving a figure.
claims.source_quote: Education that prepares people, lower tuition fees, More apprenticeships. National standards in every school.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UK Voice says it supports national standards in every school, without giving detail.
claims.source_quote: Education that prepares people, lower tuition fees, More apprenticeships. National standards in every school.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UK Voice says it supports energy independence through North Sea production, nuclear expansion and continued renewables investment.
claims.source_quote: Energy Independence North Sea production, nuclear expansion, and continued renewables investment. No Net Zero ideology at the expense of jobs and growth.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UK Voice states it opposes what it calls Net Zero ideology where it comes at the expense of jobs and growth.
claims.source_quote: Energy Independence North Sea production, nuclear expansion, and continued renewables investment. No Net Zero ideology at the expense of jobs and growth.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UK Voice says Britain's diversity is a strength and that the immigration system must be efficient, fair and publicly trusted, without giving numbers.
claims.source_quote: Controlled and Fair Britain's diversity is a strength. The system must also be efficient, fair, and publicly trusted.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UK Voice says it supports closer economic cooperation with Europe, without specifying the form.
claims.source_quote: Britain First, Not Britain Alone Closer economic cooperation with Europe. NATO commitment. A foreign policy based on British interests, not blind loyalty.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UK Voice states a commitment to NATO.
claims.source_quote: Britain First, Not Britain Alone Closer economic cooperation with Europe. NATO commitment. A foreign policy based on British interests, not blind loyalty.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged to remove VAT on green paint.
claims.source_quote: We will remove VAT on Green paint as it adds no value
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged a Summer Ice Lolly Allowance for pensioners when temperatures exceed 70 degrees.
claims.source_quote: O. OAPS will qualify for a Summer Ice Lolly Allowance if temperatures exceed 70 degrees.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged to reduce hospital waiting lists by using a smaller font.
claims.source_quote: NHS…We will reduce hospital waiting lists by using a smaller font.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged that X-ray machines will be manned by a skeleton staff.
claims.source_quote: X. X-RAY machines will be manned by a skeleton staff.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged free university tuition fees for women, extended to men under gender equality laws.
claims.source_quote: E. Education. All University Tuition fees for women would be free as we are strong believers in Female intuition. (Due to gender equality laws we would include males as well)
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged to reduce school class sizes by seating children closer together on smaller desks.
claims.source_quote: K. KIDS will be made to sit closer together on smaller desks in to reduce school class sizes.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged to ban all footwear made out of coal so that everyone can reduce their carbon footprint.
claims.source_quote: All footware made out of coal will be banned so everyone can reduce their carbon footprint
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged nationwide wind farms where breaking wind will be encouraged.
claims.source_quote: W. WIND farms will be created nationwide, where breaking wind will be encouraged.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged to reduce net migration to zero by ensuring that all green nets are secured firmly to the ground.
claims.source_quote: Net Migration Reduced to Zero by ensuring that all Green nets are secured firmly to the ground.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged to replace Border Force employees with GP receptionists.
claims.source_quote: Immigration..We will replace employees of the Border Force with GP receptionists. This will dramatically reduce the number of people getting in.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged to release innocent prisoners in order to reduce prison overcrowding.
claims.source_quote: I. INNOCENT prisoners will be released in order to reduce prison overcrowding.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party states it opposes capital punishment on the grounds that it is unfair to Londoners.
claims.source_quote: C. CAPITAL Punishment will be opposed on the grounds that it is unfair to Londoners.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged that Britain will exit Europe and join the Duchy of Cornwall to benefit from tax exemptions.
claims.source_quote: B. BRITAIN will exit Europe and join the Duchy of Cornwall to benefit from tax exemptions.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged a referendum on whether the UK should be in or out of Eurovision.
claims.source_quote: We will offer a referendum to decide whether the UK should be IN or OUT of Eurovision
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged to introduce a Court of Human Lefts to make things fairer.
claims.source_quote: Legal System…To make things fairer we will introduce a Court of Human Lefts.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)
